answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days to obtain one daily bid slot, whether it buys glacier maps, summit forecasts, or relic appraisals. Creating names is free, but creating bidding power is not: an attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize $100,000. The same funds cannot back multiple active identities, so a sybil swarm incurs a linear capital requirement and a month of lost liquidity.
